notes.title: Version Update Notification (September 28, 2018)
notes.content: - Replaced the game data with an R18 DLC patch applied [Complete Edition].

notes.title: Notification regarding the DLC patch.
notes.content:
We deeply apologize for any inconvenience caused by the bug in: "Meritocracy of the Oni & Blade [R-18 DLC for Steam Version]"

Having received feedback from our customers in regards the version of "Meritocracy of the Oni & Blade" sold on Steam, we have decided to apply the R18 contents directly to the game without a need for a DLC patch. All those who have already purchased the R18 DLC patch on DLsite.com will be refunded.

Please note that the value of this game with all its R18 contents is $20 USD. However, due to this sudden turn of events, the cost on Steam will remain $9.99 USD for a limited time. By all means, get the bargain while it's hot!
